newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Dec 1-25 palm oil exports 589,456t- SGS.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Dec 1-25 palm oil exports 589,456t- SGS.

text.p: Cargo surveyor Societe Generale de Surveillance (SGS) Malaysia Sdn Bhd said it estimated Malaysia's palm oil exports for December 1-25 at 589,456 tonnes against 555,070 tonnes in November 1-25.
It said the exports comprised 186,725 tonnes of RBD palm oil, 208,833 tonnes of RBD palm olein and 57,283 tonnes of RBD palm stearin. The other products accounted for 136,615 tonnes.
China, which was the main buyer during the period, taking 99,100 tonnes, Egypt at 83,190 tonnes, India 45,892 tonnes and Japan 39,590 tonnes.
Countries in the European Union bought 87,141 tonnes.
